selection: Post-survey exploratory addition; does not replace the nine B0 primary samples or provide an independent test

semantics.L: Human irregular-logo CANDIDATE under user appearance hint; overlap and projection alternatives not excluded
semantics.A1: Human round/ellipse candidate, not a verified physical Marker identity
semantics.A2: Human round/partial-arc candidate near lower truncation, not a verified physical Marker identity

matching: Unmodified B0 patch, appearance-template updates, matching and rejection gates
normal_tracking: Only frame10 reference to last frame, forward in time; 5ms frame10 means reference 11.750-11.755s, 2ms frame25 means 11.750-11.752s

joint_comparison.availability_gate: All specified independent patch anchors valid; no averaging, common 2D displacement assumption, or filling L from auxiliaries
joint_comparison.auxiliary_geometry_gate: L patch anchor valid and every specified auxiliary anchor valid AND at least one of its original B0 circle/ellipse gates valid
joint_comparison.primary_geometry_gate: Not required for L: noncircular candidate shape is not a circle/ellipse center model
joint_comparison.interpretation: Additional joint observations and possible coverage loss only; no automatic improvement in L matching or semantic/axis accuracy

primary_conditional_comparisons.primary_level: ambiguous assumed-irregular candidate, NOT confirmed logo
ambiguous thin-arc assumed-irregular candidate, NOT confirmed logo
